hints.title: Player Loss Tally
hints.text: Track the loss count of each player in a frequency table and keep track of every player who participated.

hints.title: Loss Count Classification
hints.text: Players with 0 losses belong in the first list. Players with exactly 1 loss belong in the second list.

hints.title: Sorted Output Requirement
hints.text: Sort both candidate lists in ascending order before returning the combined pair of lists.

hints.title: Loss Tracking Implementation

complexity.notes: Frequency table construction takes O(n), sorting players takes O(u log u) where u <= 2n.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all matches repeatedly for each unique player causes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Loss counter dictionary uses linear space in the number of unique players.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate tracks loss counts and distinguishes zero-loss participants from non-participants.
